text: RB PAY-101 [Idempotency / CorePay]: Duplicate payment idempotency key conflict on retry. Query spanner idempotency_ledger table, return original HTTP 200 settlement receipt, and suppress duplicate debit.

RB PAY-102 [Acquirer / ISO8583]: Downstream card acquirer ISO 8583 response code 91 (Issuer Inoperative) timeout. Trigger automated 0420 reversal message within 15s SLA and route traffic to secondary acquirer.

RB PAY-103 [Spanner / Ledger]: Cloud Spanner lock contention hotspot on monotonic timestamp primary key in ledger_entries. Switch primary key to shard-prefixed UUIDv4 and verify commit latency < 15ms.

RB PAY-104 [Kafka / Settlement]: Kafka Streams settlement consumer lag exceeding 500k events after partition rebalance. Verify RocksDB state store restoration, pause non-critical batch consumers, and drain topic.
RB PAY-105 [DLQ / PoisonPill]: Malformed JSON payload stuck in payment-events-dlq topic. Inspect schema version header, patch deserialization handler, and run controlled DLQ replay script.
RB PAY-106 [Compliance / PCI-Guard]: Unmasked PAN or API token detected in payment webhook audit log. Purge raw log entry immediately, rotate merchant HMAC key, and enforce tokenization filter.
RB PAY-107 [UPI / PSP]: UPI collect request callback latency spike > 5s from partner PSP. Enable circuit breaker fallback, queue pending status check cron, and notify PSP NOC.

RB PAY-108 [Reconciliation / EOD]: End-of-day Nostro ledger reconciliation mismatch of 14 unsettled batch records. Cross-check clearing file hashes against Spanner settled_txns and post adjustment journal.

RB PAY-109 [Fraud / Velocity]: Redis fraud velocity counter fallback triggered during spike. Fail-open for verified low-risk merchants under $50 while routing high-value transactions to 3DS challenge.
RB PAY-110 [Webhook / Merchant]: Merchant settlement webhook delivery failing with HTTP 429 rate limit. Apply exponential backoff with jitter and batch webhook notifications.
